notes.title: フィッシュオアチキンパッチノートVer3.5！
notes.content:
Hello to the 10 million Fish or Chicken players around the country!
It's been a month since our release, the summer sale has started, and the number of people playing our game is increasing day by day.
 so here are today's patch notes with a side of dancing chickens.

[h2]First of all, the first[/h2] 
This is the implementation of the experimental hard mode!
There are three changes to the hard mode!
[list]
[*]You can change floors even if you have not completed a mission
You can enter the exit of a floor at any time!
However, if you enter the exit without completing the mission, you will not get the experience value when you complete the mission, and
floors will advance randomly instead of one floor at a time!
[*]The upper rank limit of items has been changed from ★3 to ★6.
The upper rank limit of items will change from ★3 to ★6!
Damage percentage will increase depending on the number of ★.
Also, items up to 3★ will be available in the store!
[*]Sakana will be stronger and missions will be more difficult.
The missions will be slightly more difficult than in Normal Mode.
Sakana's night compensation will also be slightly stronger than normal.
[/list]

[h2]And now the second one! [/h2]
Various UI display changes!
The status after the bonus amount has been allocated is now displayed!
The next floor is now displayed more clearly!

[h2]And the third one[/h2]!
Chicken changes.
[list]
[*] I'm the star!
Chicken's display priority is now higher than item effects, etc.
I've decided to put it above item effects, etc., so it should be less likely to lose itself than before!


[*] The word "tough" is for chickens!
The HP bonus for rank up has been changed from a fixed value to a percentage increase.
You should now have more strength when you swing rank points to HP than before!
[*] More often
The HP recovery time for chickens has been changed from 10% of maximum HP every 60 minutes to 1%+1 of maximum HP every 6 minutes.
[/list]


[h2]Finally, the fourth! [/h2]
With the implementation of Hard Mode, we have made some adjustments to Fish's status.
There should be fewer Fish running into you at higher speeds than before.

[h2]Other bugs and various other fixes!!! [/h2]
Fixed a bug where automatic HP recovery was doubly recovering.
Fixed a bug where the arrows on the danger indicator were occurring at unintended times.

notes.title: Seriously, it's been on the market for almost a month Realy?
notes.content:
Hello, Fish or Chicken fan folk of the world!
It's time for our June Patch Notes.

This time we have further tutorial enhancements and
some UI changes and additions around HP
Some specification changes to the store system, etc.
We will introduce these three features!

[h2]First one! [/h2]
Further enhancements to the tutorials!
About the tutorial we added before.
A little... no, a lot of explanation was left out.
Perhaps it was the work of Sakana.
But don't worry!
We have added a more detailed tutorial in this patch!
It's a little bit long, but it's better to know the game than not to know it at all!


[h2] Second, we've made some UI changes to the HP area! [/h2]
If you notice, the chickens are in trouble!
I noticed that my HP was gone!
To help those of you who are in such a situation!
We have added a HP bar to the top of the chickens this time!
And even more!
When the current HP drops below 35%, the screen will turn bright red around the chicken.
This is to warn you of the danger!
Now you probably won't die suddenly anymore!

[h2]And finally! Here is the big highlight of the day! [/h2]
Improved store functionality!
Each store now has a sale on certain days of the week!
The effects of the sale are as follows
The time consumption of each store will be reduced by a certain percentage.
The probability of 2☆ items being lined up during the sale will be increased.
Stores on sale will be displayed in priority order.
Please note that the normal consumption time of each store has been increased due to the sale.

Some effects Image have been added to ☆2 items!

The probability of 2☆2 items being lined up is not based on the number of days elapsed.
The probability now changes according to the content of the previous day's LiveSteram!
The probability will increase depending on the number of comments, the number of defeats, and the number of floors progressed!

Plans for the next and subsequent editions (Plans are still undecided)
Renovation of Chicken Never Die
If you have any strange ideas, please post them on the bulletin board.

notes.title: Fish or Chicken version 3.0
notes.content:
Good day to all 10 million fish-or-chicken fans nationwide!

We have just received some very important information.
It seems that Fish, in dire straits, has summoned the power of a great dragon to overturn the war.

But rest assured, there is hope for us chickens.
Yes, there is! We can seal the dragon's power and transform its mighty power into our own!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387275/d8ed1da80081d961ad81042ac184e97ba01651ea.jpg[/img]

Let's see what this patch has in store for us!

[h2]A boss now appears when the floor reaches 10F[/h2].
When you defeat the boss, you will get the following dragon powers depending on the color of the boss!
[olist]
[*] Increased damage
[*] Damage barrier based on max hp
[*] Fixed reload time reduction
[*] Increased boost effect limit
[/olist]
You can get up to 4 dragon powers.
However, please pay attention to the remaining time when challenging!
If you miss the boss, you will not be able to get the power of the dragon on that floor.

If you can defeat this boss, your dragon's buff will increase by one level for a certain number of floors (until the next boss floor)!
your dragon's buff will be increased by one level for a certain period of time (until the next boss floor)!
Please use this huge power to make the delivery more exciting!
The boss does not appear in the ending at this time.

[h2]Correction of spacha effect[/h2].
The spacha effect was a little too strong, so to balance it out
The maximum value of the spacha effect has been set, and the fixed value increase has been changed to a percentage increase.
The maximum spacha effect is a 90% increase in status

The amount of fixed status increase at rank-up has been changed from +1 to +2.

[h2]Changed specifications of some items[/h2].
The effect values of some weapons have been changed and corrected.

Bug where HP would recover beyond the maximum HP when using items with recovery effects.

notes.title: New functions, new modes, new specifications
notes.content:
Good evening, fans of Fish or Chicken around the world!
It's time for Patch Notes 2.2.

In this patch, we have changed the item specifications, added behavior when zooming out
We have also changed the start and finish positions, and added a new challenge mode.
Please take a look at the following.

[h3]Item Specification Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Item reload specifications changed.
Until now, the reload time of each equipped item was used for firing,
From this patch, 
The reload time is now calculated by adding up the reload times of all equipped items and dividing by the number of items equipped.

[*]Adjustment of item reload times
The reload times for all items have been revised to reflect the above changes.
It is interesting to consider not only the behavior but also the combination of reload times as a criterion for purchasing items in the future.


[*]Intent of Specification Change
With the previous specifications, it was only necessary to raise the Stars of the item.
The build for rank-up was almost exclusively based on ATK.
With this change, it is now possible to use a combination of items, or to use haste in rank ups.
I thought it would be more interesting if the range of play increased, for example, by using equipment with a long reload time
I thought it would be more interesting and implemented.
The gauge to attack was added under the character's name.
[/list]

[h3]Add functionality when zooming out[/h3]
Did you all know that Fish or Chicken has a zoom out feature?
What? It's not mentioned in the manual? You may be right.
In fact, you can zoom out by left-clicking or holding down the L button...

[list]
[*]Addition of changes in behavior when zooming out for each chicken.
While zooming out, the movement speed is reduced, except for some classes,
Reload time will be reduced instead.
The individuality of the chickens will be even stronger than before.
[/list]

[h3]New game mode[/h3]
[list]
[*]One night Festival is back.
As a new challenge to the game mode.
We have added a new mode where class characteristics are maxed out from the beginning and the deadline is one day.
Challenge yourself and see how far you can go with the unusual specifications!
[/list]

[h3]Various other additions[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changed the UI to the exit displayed when a mission is cleared.
[*]The floor now always starts in the center and the goal is randomly placed from 8 different directions.
[*]When hovering over an item in the inventory, if the same item is available in the store, it will now be displayed.
[*]Items of the same rank in the store will now also be displayed if they are of a different rank.
[*]The Good Luck indicator has been changed.
[/list]

It seems that I, as the UI designer, have gone a little overboard!
I have changed the colors around the UI, which were too stimulating, to calm colors as much as possible.
Hopefully this will reduce the amount of damage to your eyeballs...

[h1]Game balance adjustment[/h1].

[h2]This is where the real fight begins! [/h2]
Dear all, Are you playing Chicken Never Die?
This mode has been a bit of a challenge to balance.
So we have decided to enhance the sakanas to the extent that it does not interfere too much with the other two modes.
The sharks after the 50th floor are stronger than before.
(There is still no change in behavior, etc.)
If you don't proceed more carefully than before, the danger is dangerous...?

[h2]Too Big to Match[/h2].
the contact point of some of the larger fish was inside the contact point of the collider
This bug has been fixed.
Please be careful of larger fish than before.
Also, the hit detection of marlin targets has been removed by this fix.

[h1]Weapon adjustments[/h1].

[h2]Faster and more accurate[/h2].
The timing of the "一文字" from attack has been changed from
The timing of the attack has been changed from the end of the animation to the end of the animation, so that the hit detection continues throughout the animation,
This should make it easier to use than before.

[h1]Mission adjustments[/h1].

[h2]Keep the comments coming! [/h2]
We have increased the speed at which comment missions increase.
If you earn a lot of comments by doing this
You should be able to complete a mission in 1/2 the time it took before!

[h2]It's more fun if you go for it! [/h2]
With the adjustments we have made after 50F this time
We have removed the function to double the mission quota after 50F.
This will speed up the progress after 50F, but please note that the further you progress, the stronger the enemies will be.

Other minor bug fixes
Added the ability to return to the title by pressing the BACK button during mode select.

notes.title: バグ修正とバランス調整
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes and Balance Adjustments[/h2].
With the previous modifications to the comment section that we made.
There was a bug that caused the entire game to become heavy.
We apologize for that.
We hope that this patch will fix the bug and you will be able to play the game comfortably again.
With the above fixes, we have lowered the limit on the number of comments for [u]stage missions.
[/u]

[h2]About Drop Items[/h2].
The drop ratio of status items has decreased due to the recovery items added in the last issue.

Therefore, [u]we[/u] have increased the basic drop rate from 3% to 6%[/u].
We have also made a significant change to the values of the Chamois class characteristics.
Although the advantage of Chamois compared to other classes has been reduced, the drop rate at low ranks has been slightly increased.

[h2]Enhanced drop items[/h2].
Along with the above changes, the performance of [u]drop items[/u] has been uniformly enhanced.
[u]Attack:Movement:HP increased from 1 to 2[/u].
This should greatly strengthen chicken along with the increased drop rate.

[h2]Status Adjustment[/h2].
[u]Make all basic statuses uniform[/u] and
balance based on the rank-up correction.
[u]Basic HP:100[/u].
[u]Basic Attack Power:20[/u].
[u]Basic movement speed:20[/u].
(excluding kazami and mechazami)

Initial item changes
u]Items[/u] that can be initially selected[/u] from 一文字
[u]Changed to [u]ハンマー兄弟[/u].

Confirmed bugs
UI of EXIT may shift from the player's aircraft

Other minor UI fixes

notes.title: Major balancing
notes.content:
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
Hello everyone, I'm back with another round of balance adjustments.
This balance adjustment is quite a big one!
There may be adjustments to status and performance within a few patches.
Below are the details of the adjustments.

[h2]Performance of drop items[/h2].
HP was recovered when drop items were acquired, but this recovery feature has been removed.

The HP increase for drop items was a little too strong.
Therefore, we have lowered the value significantly this time.
We may change the value back a little, depending on the situation.
The maximum HP increase has been reduced from
5 to 1

Due to the discontinuation of the recovery function
Items that recover HP are now dropped.
This item recovers a certain amount of HP according to the maximum HP amount.

[h2]Class Adjustments[/h2].
Shamo's class skill "Drop Rate UP" was
was a little too powerful, so we decided to lower it a little.
Maximum drop rate UP 400% -> 300%.

The basic status, which had been uniform up to now, has been adjusted individually for each class.
Basic status is now adjusted individually for each class.
When the mouse cursor is moved over a class, the status screen appears in the lower right corner of the screen.

[h2]Equipment item adjustments[/h2].
The damage multiplier and blow-off rate for sibilance rails have been adjusted.
The damage was made stronger because of the need to ram into the enemy.
There was no risk because the enemy would die before it hit.
Damage multiplier: 200% to 125%.

[h2]Other[/h2].
The comment field now flows smoothly.
This will allow comments that were previously truncated to be displayed to flow!

And here you go!
The sound effect and the icon in the lower left corner of the screen will now shake when a player is hit by damage!
This will reduce the possibility of the distribution being terminated before you know it.
Please give some love to the lower left corner of the screen from time to time.

notes.title: Manuals for English-speaking countries have been added.
notes.content:
Sorry to keep you waiting!
I don't know what kind of game this is.
I don't know what to do.
Because everything is in Japanese!
But don't worry!
We added the manual pdf to Steam today!
If you read this, you will understand 50% of the game!
The other half you will realize when you actually play the game!

notes.content:
[h2]Check your fix with Chicken! [/h2]
Sorry! I was in too much of a hurry.

If the delivery ended with a floor mission completed
